title: Designing a Boundary Negotiating Artifact for Collaborative Socio-Technical Sense-Making in AI Regulatory Sandboxes
abstract: arXiv:2609.37109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid, unpredictable advancements in AI system capabilities has seen regulators take adaptive and experimental approaches to policymaking. Established in other domains as instruments balancing regulation with innovation, regulatory sandboxes are seen as solutions for AI regulation. However, analyses mostly focus on the legal and institutional design of AI Regulatory Sandboxes (AIRSes). With the legal framework leaving the socio-technical interpretation to stakeholders, this creates a gap on the sense-making required to fulfill the AIRS purpose. In this paper, we approach this by designing a Boundary Negotiating Artifact as a way to mediate meaning in AIRSes. Through Research-through-Design we iteratively develop a tool, providing an interface for the different stakeholders to collaborate in AI assessment. translated_title: 设计一种边界协商制品以促进AI监管沙盒中的协作式社会技术意义建构
translated_abstract: 摘要：AI系统能力的快速且不可预测的发展，促使监管者在政策制定中采取适应性和实验性的方法。监管沙盒作为平衡监管与创新的工具已在其他领域得到确立，并被视为AI监管的解决方案。然而，现有分析大多聚焦于AI监管沙盒（AIRS）的法律与制度设计。由于法律框架将社会技术层面的解读留给了各利益相关者，这在实现AIRS目标所需的意义建构方面造成了空白。本文通过设计一个“边界协商制品”来应对这一问题，以此作为在AIRS中调解意义的手段。通过“通过设计进行研究”的方法，我们迭代开发了一个工具，为不同利益相关者提供协作开展AI评估的接口。随后，我们将其定位为既有AIRS框架中的技术骨干，以构建相关方的协作式意义建构。
tldr: 针对AI监管沙盒法律框架下留给利益相关者的社会技术意义建构空白，本文通过设计研究法迭代开发了一种边界协商制品，为多方利益相关者协作开展AI评估提供接口，并作为技术骨干嵌入现有AIRS框架中支撑协作式意义建构。
en_tdlr: To bridge the socio-technical sense-making gap left by legal frameworks in AI Regulatory Sandboxes, this paper employs Research-through-Design to iteratively develop a Boundary Negotiating Artifact that enables diverse stakeholders to collaboratively conduct AI assessment and serves as the technical backbone within established AIRS frameworks.
